# Sirach Chapter 30 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 30 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**30:1** He-who-loves his-son will-continue-to-chastise him, that-he-may-rejoice over him in-the-end and not-be-grieved in-the-presence-of his-neighbors.

**30:2** He-who-disciplines his-son will-be-benefited by-him, and among his-acquaintances he-will-boast-of-him.

**30:3** He-who-teaches his-son will-provoke-jealousy in-his-enemy, and before-friends he-will-rejoice over-him.

**30:4** His-father-dies, and it-is-as-if he-has-not-died, for he-has-left-behind [one]-like-himself.

**30:5** In-his-life he-saw him and rejoiced-over-him, and in-his-death he-was-not-grieved.

**30:6** Against-enemies he-left-behind an-avenger, and to-friends one-returning-favor.

**30:7** He-who-coddles his-son will-bind-up his-wounds, and his-heart will-be-shaken at-every-outcry.

**30:8** An-unbroken-horse becomes-stubborn, and a-son-who-is-left-to-himself becomes headstrong.

**30:9** Pamper your-child and he-will-terrify you; play-with-him and he-will-make-you-grieve.

**30:10** Do-not-laugh with-him lest you-grieve-with-him, and at-the-end you-will-gnash-your-teeth.

**30:11** Do-not-give him freedom in-his-youth, and do-not-ignore his-follies.

**30:12** Bow-down his-neck in-his-youth and beat-his-ribs while-he-is-still-young, lest he-become-stubborn and he-will-not-obey-you and there-will-be-grief to-your-soul.

**30:13** Discipline your-son and labor over-him, lest in-his-shameful-behavior you-stumble.

**30:14** Better is a-poor-man who-is-healthy and-strong in-his-body than a-rich-man who-is-oppressed in-his-flesh.

**30:15** Health and wholeness are-better-than all-gold, and a-robust-body better-than unlimited-wealth.

**30:16** There-is-no-wealth better-than health of-body, and no-gladness better-than joy-of-heart.

**30:17** Better-is-death than a-bitter life, and an-eternal-rest than a-chronic-illness.

**30:18** Good-things poured-out on a-mouth that-is-closed are-like-offerings placed before a-tomb.

**30:19** What-does an-idol-offering profit? For it-can-neither-eat nor-smell; so also the-one-who-is-punished by-the-LORD —

**30:20** seeing with-his-eyes and groaning as a-eunuch who-embraces a-virgin and-sighs.

**30:21** Do-not-give your-soul to-sorrow, and do-not-torment-yourself in-your-own-counsel.

**30:22** Joy-of-heart is-the-life of a-man, and the-rejoicing of a-man is length-of-days.

**30:23** Deceive yourself and console your-soul; and keep-away sorrow-of-heart from-yourself; for sorrow has-killed-off many, and there-is-no-advantage in-it.

**30:24** Jealousy and anger shorten-life, and worry brings-on old-age-before-its-time.

**30:25** A-bright and-a-good heart will-have-delight in-his-food, and his-nourishment he-will-take-care-of.
